title: Editing a recipe and making a new one look different
boardTitle: DT346: editing a recipe, a recipe's copy on the Plate and a new dish look different

opportunity.from: Coach Milan's own look, 23 November 2026, 19:03, after making a recipe of his own, Lazy Burek.
opportunity.job: Change a recipe, or cook a changed version of it once, and know which of the two he is doing.
opportunity.kind: Did not find it or did not understand it: the three states look alike, so it is not clear where a change goes.
opportunity.why_now: In Now with the Recipes batch (Coach Milan 26 November 10:32), with the design rules D10, D15 and D16 applied to what it touches.

problem: Changing the recipe itself, changing a copy of it on the Plate, and making a new dish on the Plate look almost the same. Nothing says where a change goes: to the recipe, to this meal only, or to a new recipe. On the Plate the answer comes at the end, at Eat, and for a recipe that says how many servings it makes it never comes.
story: When I change the foods of a recipe, I want to see at once whether I am changing the recipe or only what I cook now, so I never change it by mistake and never lose a change I meant to keep.
now: In main, 0.3.200, four rows below. DT346.1 Edit recipe changes the recipe in place; the only sign is the small tag Editing the recipe. DT346.2 Put it on the Plate, a recipe that makes 4 servings: the Plate says From your screenshot, and Eat says the recipe is in My recipes already; the change stays on that meal and the recipe keeps 375 g. DT346.3 Put it on the Plate, a recipe for one plate: From My recipes, and Eat asks Update my recipe, Save as a new recipe or Only this time. DT346.4 a new dish: Name it, or keep the foods' name, and Save in My recipes at Eat. 3b and 4b are the same screen but for one line.
found: Found while drawing, all in main 0.3.200: 1. the second state is two: a recipe with servings and one without behave differently (DT346.2, DT346.3). 2. A recipe made by hand that says how many servings it makes is called From your screenshot on the Plate (DT346.2b). 3. A change on the Plate to such a recipe never reaches it, and nothing asks (DT346.2e, 2f). 4. Save it to My recipes shows on the Plate for a recipe that is in My recipes already (DT346.3b). 5. The design rules: Cancel in Edit recipe has 12 px corners, not 14 (D16, DT346.1b); Eat's choices, Update my recipe and Yes, save it, are 34 px high, under 44 (D10, DT346.3e, 4e); the main buttons sit 6 px apart on the Plate (Prepare it, Save it to My recipes), 22 px apart in Edit recipe.
proposed: Drawn 27 November 10:50 as DT346.5 and DT346.6, under DT346.2 and DT346.3. One rule for every recipe of mine on the Plate, servings or not: 1. the Plate holds a copy; the recipe stays as it is until I choose. 2. At the first change a line under the title says so: Changed from Lazy Burek: Frischer Blätterteig 375 to 300 g. The recipe stays as it is; Eat asks whether the change goes back to it. 3. Eat asks once, only when something changed: Update my recipe, Save as a new recipe, Only this time (the default); with one portion on the plate, Update my recipe scales the change back to the whole recipe. 4. A recipe I made says From My recipes, never From your screenshot. Also: after a change the main step is Prepare it, not Prepare it as it is; the ask's chips are 44 px (D10). Edit recipe (DT346.1) and a new dish (DT346.4): their look is chosen next.
looked_at: The recipe always stays as it is for a recipe with servings (DT346.2 as in main): not chosen, because whether a recipe has servings is about portions, not about where my change goes, and a change I meant to keep is lost without a word.
decision: Scope, Coach Milan 26 November 14:25: draw the states as they are in main first; make them look clearly different, with the design rules (D10, D15, D16, type weights 400, 600, 700, 900) applied to what it touches. Out: cook mode, a member's recipe page, Plan. 27 November 10:45: yes, draw the new flow (one rule for every recipe, the line at the first change, the question at Eat, From My recipes). No Go yet.
